name: Loni Kalbhor
notes: Independent Gram Panchayat (LGD local body code 185740, 'LONIKALBHOR'). Population/households cross-verified across census2011.co.in and villageinfo.org (both report 22,518 / 4,720). Coordinates from OpenStreetMap (Nominatim), which agrees with the basemap the GIS screen draws. They were previously taken from a Wikipedia infobox written to arcminute precision (18°29'N 74°02'E) — about 1.3 km out, and enough to open the map off the village.

name: Wagholi
notes: Census Town (CT). Population/households cross-verified (census2011.co.in subdistrict table and etrace.in both report 33,479 / matching household count). Officially merged into Pune Municipal Corporation in the June 2021 merger of 23 fringe villages (confirmed by Wikipedia and multiple news reports, and by PMC splitting Wagholi into election wards). The March-2022 LGD snapshot used here still lists an active local-body code (185785), which appears to be administrative lag rather than evidence the Gram Panchayat still functions -- treat Wagholi as NOT having an independent GP today. Coordinates from OpenStreetMap (Nominatim), checked to fall within Haveli taluka.
